LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ManagerTip: The jobs Colony Manager keeps on this map, read from the mod each hour: what each counts, what there is now and the target it works to. The council only reads them; a target changes only when you press a suggestion's button, and Undo puts it back.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_JobTip: The manager's job, as Colony Manager names it.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_CountsTip: What the job counts toward its target: the meat, wood or minerals it brings in, or the animals of a herd.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_NowTip: What there is now, counted the way the manager counts it.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_TargetTip: The count the job works up to. At its target it stops until the count falls again.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_StateTip: Working, at its target, suspended, or wanting more than its target: what the colony's stocks, blueprints and chains want of its goods.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_JobTipHerd: {JOB} keeps a herd of {GOODS}: {NOW} tame now, {TARGET} wanted in all.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Want_Meat: The raw food is low: of the {TARGET} nutrition to keep, {SHARE}% is meat by what the colony ate lately, about {MEAT} pieces of meat.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Want_Shop: The colony wants {WANT} {WHAT} and has {HAVE} (the shopping list).
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Want_Fuel: The colony used about {ADAY} a day lately (fires, stoves, generators and bills), {KEEP} for {DAYS} days.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Raise_Title: Raise the {JOB} target in Colony Manager from {FROM} to {TO}
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Raise_Capped: The job's slider goes no higher than {0}.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Raise_Stalled: The manager is idle now, so the new target waits until that is put right (see its own suggestion).
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Do_RaiseTip: Sets the {JOB} job's target in Colony Manager from {FROM} to {TO}, so the manager marks more until the count reaches it. Undo puts it back to {FROM}.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Do_ResumeTip: Resumes the {0} job in Colony Manager, so its manager works it again. Undo suspends it again.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_nodesk: Colony Manager has no manager desk
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_deskoff: The manager desk can't be used
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_nomanager: Nobody works as Colony Manager's manager
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_nobodycan: Nobody here can be Colony Manager's manager
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_NoDeskWhy: A manager works them at a manager desk, and the colony has none. A {0} can be built now from the Production menu.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_NoDeskResearch: A manager works them at a manager desk, and the colony has none it can build yet.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_DeskForbidden: The {0} is forbidden, so no manager goes to it.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Stall_DeskOffWhy: The {0} has no power or is broken down, so no manager can work at it.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Do_AllowTip: Allows the {0}, so a manager can work at it. Undo forbids it again.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_NotYet_JobGone: The job is no longer in Colony Manager.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_NotYet_Manager: The manager hasn't brought more in yet: {NOW} {GOODS} of {TARGET}. There may be nothing more to take within its area.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_NotYet_Mine: {MINED} of the {MARKED} cells are mined; {MINERS} colonists have mining switched on, and other work may come first.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopTitle: Shopping list for the next trader
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopTip: What the colony wants and can't make here, worked out each hour from its stocks, blueprints, bills and chains: what no bench here makes and no field grows (neutroamine for medicine, steel for components, components before Fabrication, the blueprints' materials), less what is in store and what is already marked to mine. A trader on the map or in orbit is checked for what of it they carry.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_ItemTip: A thing the colony wants and can't make here.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_ShortTip: How many to buy: what is wanted less what is in store and what is marked to mine.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_HaveTip: What is in store against what all the reasons together would use.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_WorthTip: What the short ones are worth at their base price; a trader asks more.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Col_TraderTip: What a trader here has of it, or that a deposit of it is known on the map to mine.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopLine: {WHAT}: the colony wants {WANT} ({WHY}) and has {HAVE}: {SHORT} short.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopPending: The rock marked to mine gives about {0} more.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopTipManager: Colony Manager's mining job mines it, so a higher target there is suggested rather than marking rock by hand.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopTipDeposit: A deposit of it is known on the map: a suggestion marks the nearest for mining.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopWhy_Chunks: made here only from {0}, and there is none
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopWhy_Bill: for the bill at the {0}, {1} batches
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopWhy_MedicineItself: medicine to keep, {0}, and no bench here makes it
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_ShopWhy_Clothes: {0} worn below half or soon, none made here
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_NoTrader: No trader is on the map or in orbit now.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Trader_Unread: {NAME}, {WHERE}: what they carry couldn't be read.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Mine_Title: Mark {CELLS} cells of {ROCK} to mine for {WHAT}
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Mine_Why: The nearest known deposit the colony can walk up to is {FAR} cells from the colony's middle, {LUMP} cells of rock at about {EACH} {WHAT} each; {CELLS} cells give about {GIVES}. Each marked cell is one the miners can reach once the one before is mined, and none leaves a roof without a support in reach.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Do_MineTip: Marks {CELLS} cells of {ROCK} for mining, those nearest the way in first. Undo takes the marks off the cells not mined yet.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_Worn: The colony's people wear {WORN} {WHAT}: {FRAYED} below half their hit points now, {SOON} more within {DAYS} days at their wear.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_WornOut: By the record about {ADAY} a day wear through, {IN} in {DAYS} days.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_Have: {SPARE} whole ones in store and the bills make {BILLS} more: {SHORT} short.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_Raise: The bill at the {BENCH} makes them until {FROM}; {TO} keeps enough spares.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_Add: The {BENCH} can make them ({PARTS} a piece, in store), and no bill does.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_AddTip: Adds a bill at the {BENCH}: make {WHAT} until {N} whole ones are in store (worn ones below half don't count). Undo takes the bill off.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Clothes_NoParts: The {BENCH} could make them, but what a piece takes ({PARTS}) isn't in store.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_FieldsHay: Of what the fields give, {HAY} a day is animal feed only (hay and the like), never counted toward the people's {PEOPLE} a day.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Why_QuestJoining: {0} more once the people an accepted quest brings join.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_BusyRecorded: the {BENCH}, worked about {WORKED} hours a day lately, with {HOURS} hours of work waiting
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Room_Mine: That counts {CELLS} cells of rock to mine first, about {HOURS} hours for one miner; the {MINERS} miners mine about {ADAY} hours a day.
LanguageData.CC_AheadMore_Room_MineNobody: That counts {CELLS} cells of rock to mine first, about {HOURS} hours, and nobody has mining switched on.
